ideas.pitch: An emergency triage chatbot and symptom analyzer that connects distressed pet owners instantly with local emergency veterinary resources and provides immediate first-aid guidance.
ideas.title: PawGuard: AI-Driven Emergency Triage for PetsParivar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the PetTech & Animal Welfare track and aligns with the sponsor PetsParivar, addressing the Smart Pet Healthcare & Emergency Assistance challenge.

ideas.pitch: A matching platform that uses preference vectors and behavioral quiz data to pair shelter animals with suitable adopters, reducing return rates and streamlining responsible pet adoption.
ideas.title: AdoptMatch: Intelligent Behavior-Based Pet Adoption Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Responsible Pet Adoption & Animal Welfare challenge within the PetTech track, offering judges a practical, socially impactful workflow.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile web tool for campus students and cleaning staff to instantly classify waste items and log recycling metrics to optimize campus waste management.
ideas.title: EcoBin: Smart Campus Waste Segregation and Audit System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tailored precisely to the Smart Campus & Smart City track and the Smart Waste Management & Sustainability challenge.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency student safety application featuring instant geo-fenced SOS broadcasting, automated emergency alerts, and quick campus security dispatch coordination.
ideas.title: CampusSafe: Real-time Emergency Response and SOS Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly answers the Student Safety & Emergency Response challenge under the Smart Campus & Smart City track, solving a high-priority real-world problem for university administrations.

ideas.pitch: An AI platform that translates and adapts educational materials into accessible formats, including simplified text, audio descriptions, and sign language video generation prompts for students with disabilities.
ideas.title: EduAccess: Multi-Modal AI Assistant for Inclusive Learning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the AI for Accessibility & Inclusive Education challenge within the AI & Smart Technology track, scoring high on social impact and inclusive design.
